basic_details.job_title: Kannur University Sports Physiotherapist / Physiotherapist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kannur University has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Sports Physiotherapist / Physiotherapist with specialization in Musculoskeletal Therapy to be filled on a contract basis for a period of one year or till the vacancy is filled up, whichever is earlier. The selected candidate will be posted at Mangattuparamba Campus with a monthly pay of Rs. 28,000 per month. Applicants must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Physiotherapy or Diploma in Physiotherapy from an institution recognized by the State Government, and the age limit is 18-40 with usual relaxation to SC/ST and other eligible candidates.
